Welcome to Florida Farm School & Animal Rescue, a heartwarming family farm run by Sarah, a single mom of two boys and countless beloved farm animals! After eight long years of running a construction business, Sarah decided to trade the hustle and bustle for a simpler, more fulfilling life surrounded by nature. Afterall, it was withing months of being in the country life that she realized just how much "life" she missed out on living in the American Programming. 

At our farm, we believe in the value of slowing down, connecting with animals, and embracing the peaceful rhythms of country living. Sarah's mission is to share this experience with others through hands-on education, unique opportunities, and heartfelt rescue efforts for animals in need. Whether it's through our farm school, events, camping, or animal rescue work, we invite you to discover the joy of farm life with us! Reach Out! Info@floridafarmschool.org
